title: bug: `git push` fails the first time with git-credential-manager
body:
### Description

Whenever I do `git push` or something that requires authentication, it fails the first time. Repeating the same command makes it work, and it keeps working for a while after that. Attached below is a screenshot of how it looks. I'm using `git-credential-manager` for `https` auth. The issue doesn't happen for any other git services e.g. GitHub.

I think it's happening due to `git-credential-manager` not refreshing the tokens in time. Since this isn't happening with any other git provider, I'm not sure whether this is a problem of `git-credential-manager` or `forgejo` itself.

[Link to forgejo next repo.](https://next.forgejo.org/test_acc/test_repo)

### Forgejo Version

1.21.8+0

### Can you reproduce the bug on Forgejo Next?

Yes

_No response_

It is being run using `docker` from the `codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo:1.21` image.
